steps.title: Four disclosure systems, one map
steps.text: Contributions, behested payments, lobbying and contracts. Individuals are aggregated; timing is never proof.

steps.title: The shape of the network
steps.text: Thick channels, not a hairball: contractors to departments, PACs to committees, clients to lobbyists.

steps.title: The ban window, with a base rate
steps.text: 40% of contributions would fall in a window by chance; 21 records to covered officials appear to warrant review.

steps.title: Behested payments
steps.text: $6.6 million since 2019. Interested-party payors are flagged to check, not to accuse.

steps.title: Who lobbies whom
steps.text: Contacts by client and department; topics show what they were about.

steps.title: Concentration
steps.text: For the median committee the top ten named sources give 89% of named dollars.

steps.title: The nonprofit loop
steps.text: 38 city-funded nonprofits also receive behested payments or hire lobbyists. Lawful, disclosed, and worth seeing in one place.
